description: Applicant institution rectifies flagged deficiencies by uploading certified supplementary evidence and formal rejoinder within the statutory cure window.
aphClauseCitation: APH 2024-2027 Chapter I Cl. 1.7, 1.8 & Chapter II Cl. 2.19

entryPrerequisites.description: At least one unresolved deficiency record must exist on the case.

validationRules: Every flagged deficiency must have an uploaded corrective document version
Submission must be completed prior to deficiency cure deadline
Applicant declaration of compliance must be confirmed

allowedTransitions.buttonLabel: Refer to Standing Hearing Committee (Deadline Missed)
validationRules: Cure deadline must have expired (NOW() > deficiency_due_date)
Institution failed to submit complete rectification within permitted window

timePolicy.description: Deficiency cure SLA: Institution is given 7 calendar days to upload compliant rectification evidence.

exitConditions.description: Institution re-submits evidence or case escalates to Standing Hearing Committee.
verificationCriteria: Rectification payload received or timer expiry flag recorded
